title: Awnings in the Sun

arrangement.description_ja: マリンバの明るい街角、裏拍のギター、長短の会話

caption: Instrumental original handheld JRPG town cue in C major, 4/4, 112 quarter-note BPM. Preserve the complete supplied 16-bar independent melody, varied phrase rests, explicit scene-specific support and bass. marimba lead with nylon_guitar support. Clean restrained timbres, no extra notes or reharmonization, no distortion, vocals or fade.
form_description: 16 bars in 4/4: jaunty eight-bar marimba tune in two unequal four-bar sentences; four-bar vibraphone shade with longer notes; four-bar new high-register hook and open pickup.
composition_notes: Independently authored literal tune, meter, form and groove for this region. Scalar passing notes retain their melodic shape while accompaniment thins to a consonant single tone or dyad; they are not forced into arpeggiated triads. A nearest-motion triadic anchor path guides harmonic direction. Independently selected bass avoids exposed parallel fifths/octaves, and scene-specific rests break its automatic doubling of the lead rhythm. Actual score and MIDI events are separately audited; this is not a claim of human listening approval.

harmonic_policy.scalar_melody_policy: Thinned support at nonchord melodic notes; independently scored bass, no fixed-root pedal that clashes with passing tones
harmonic_policy.bass_voice: Independent movement with exposed parallel fifth/octave avoidance
harmonic_policy.release_policy: Per-part release gates before unsafe pitch/harmony transitions; no old support tail may create an unintended clash

voice_leading.parallel_perfect_policy: Avoid exposed same-direction parallel fifths/octaves, including loop
voice_leading.counterpoint_scope: Independent melody and bass; explicit chordal orchestration is not claimed as species counterpoint
voice_leading.harmony: Voice-led triadic anchors; only consonant filtered portions are sounded during passing notes
